items.label: Nightstand with Charging Station
items.value: This white night stand comes with built-in 2 outlets and 2 USB ports, as well as a 4.9 foot power cord. Provide a convenient charging place for your mobile phone, Bluetooth earphones, watches, lamp and laptop, everything is within your arm's reach.

items.label: 2 Fabric Drawers
items.value: The front of the drawer is made of PVC, while the rest are made of fabric, breathable and prevent dust, make table is lightweight. Sealed drawers for storing snacks, toys and other everyday items. It is ideal for storing personal items. Drawers bottom hold up to 7 lbs.

items.label: Security Upgrade
items.value: Considering safety issues, our socket is installed on the backboard to avoid electric shock caused by coffee splashing, and save desktop space, allowing small table top to store more items.

items.label: End Table with 2 Hooks
items.value: Equipped with 2 S-shaped metal hooks to add extra storage space. You can hang headphones, file folders, keys, small backpacks, hats and so on. Removable hooks can be hung on the side table or in other place.

items.label: Versatile Side Table
items.value: This table with 2 drawers and 2-tier open shelves gives you plenty of storage space. Enough to store your photos, books, lamps, mobile phones, alarm clocks and other daily necessities, keep your room organized.

items.label: Solid Structure
items.value: Exquisite particle board and metal frame combination, provide stable support. 4 adjustable feet keep leveling and avoiding scratching the floor. Easy to clean, wipe gently with a damp cloth, the table looks new.

items.label: Worry-Free Service
items.value: Product size:14.96"D x 11.75"W x 22.25"H, manual with detailed operation instructions, the hardware and tools included and each accessory is labeled for easy installation. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
